source: TASK-20261029-mod-planetary-drill-sub1 (D672, D678, D679), BUG-20261030-customtypes-drill-pack-dogma (D700). Planetary Drill 340100 = clone of Orbital Skyhook 81080; Planetary Drill Blueprint 340101 = clone of Spatial Attunement Unit Blueprint 33196 (like the PI blueprints, D693) with groupID 1045 Sovereignty Structure Blueprint (category 9, the Orbital Skyhook Blueprint group): Orbital Skyhook Blueprint 81086 has no typeDogma record, so the client encoder cannot clone it (D700). Manufacturing materials, time, skill, limit, copying and research times = Vexor Blueprint 971 (SDE 3396210 blueprints.jsonl), no invention. iconID 26063 = skyhook category icon (the client tool needs one; 81080 carries no iconID, so the client keeps its look for the drill; 33196 does, so the blueprint gets 26063). marketGroupID null: no market on the server. v4: TASK-20261030-pdrill-pi-select-command (D839-D846): 15 Planetary Drill (<P0>) variants 340102-340116 (clones of 81080, the P0 is fixed by the launched item; the [PI:] name tag is gone from the descriptions) and their blueprints 340202-340216 (clones of 33196, group 1045, manufacturing, copying and research = 340101). Client: re-run ApplyClientData.

overrides.name: Planetary Drill
overrides.description: Launch it for Corporation (Station Manager role) at a planet outside sovereignty nullsec: it becomes a Skyhook that mines the planet's highest-quality raw resource (P0) from that planet into its secured bay; Extract moves it to your ship. The mined resource cannot be changed after launch; scooping the Skyhook gives back a plain Orbital Skyhook. In sovereignty nullsec it is an ordinary Skyhook (vanilla reagents). For a specific P0 use a Planetary Drill variant, e.g. Planetary Drill (Aqueous Liquids).

overrides.name: Planetary Drill Blueprint
overrides.description: Blueprint of the Planetary Drill (auto: the planet's highest-quality P0), a launchable Skyhook that mines a planet's raw resource (P0) outside sovereignty nullsec. See the item description.

overrides.name: Planetary Drill (Microorganisms)
overrides.description: Launch it for Corporation (Station Manager role) at a planet outside sovereignty nullsec: it becomes a Skyhook that mines Microorganisms (raw planetary resource, P0) from that planet into its secured bay; Extract moves it to your ship. Microorganisms is found on Temperate, Ice, Oceanic and Barren planets. At a planet without Microorganisms the launch is refused and the drill stays in your cargo hold - check the planet type first. The mined resource cannot be changed after launch; scooping the Skyhook gives back a plain Orbital Skyhook. In sovereignty nullsec it is an ordinary Skyhook (vanilla reagents).
